newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate up further, baht firmer late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate up further, baht firmer late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate rose to 10.50-11.00 percent late on Wednesday from 9.50-10.00 percent earlier on tighter liquidity ahead of a central bank reserve requirment, dealers said.

"Banks continued to borrow funds for the reserve requirement. The heavy buying of the dollar also added demands for funds," said one dealer at a foreign bank. Banks have to pay a reserve requirement on the seventh and 22nd of each month.
The baht edged up slightly to 25.512-25.517 to the dollar late from 25.515-25.520 early on late dollar selling, dealers said.
